rd.researchQuestion: Is the Terminal / Character-Grid family sufficient to express a Customer Inquiry -> Account Detail -> Transaction History workflow without product-specific abstractions, and which Forma capability gaps does it expose?
rd.experimentalObjective: Encode the three screens and their states as family data and check every relational rule mechanically.
